Thanks Aisha — attaching a small traffic sample (prod_traffic_sample.csv) and I've filled the top-level fields in your workbook where useful.

Quick answers:
- Current steady-state TPS: ~18 req/s. Typical daily spike window ~07:00-09:00 PT where we see sustained 60 req/s for ~30 minutes. Max observed burst ~120 req/s for <2 minutes.
- Chat vs single-turn: ~65% chat (multi-turn with KV cache reuse), 35% single-turn.
- Token mix (avg): prompt 200 tokens, completion 120 tokens; 95th pct prompt 800 tokens.
- Concurrency: we have ~120 concurrent agents during spikes; p95 latency SLO target 250ms for user-facing requests.
- Security: prefer VPC-first but want to evaluate Dedicated with optional Private later. Will likely need KMS integration later.
- GPU preference: we don't have a hard constraint; curious about H100 vs A100 tradeoffs.

Also, pricing: ballpark monthly committed cost target is ~$35k–$55k depending on performance.

Happy to jump on the Wed slot if confirmed.

—Miguel

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Fwd: Dedicated vs VPC: sizing clarifications & workbook (post-call)

Aisha — quick sizing note based on Miguel's sample (see attached sizing_estimate_v1.xlsx). High level:
- Recommendation: H100-backed Dedicated pool for lowest p95 latency at the observed token mix. With quantized 4-bit weights and our batching/KV cache we estimate ~35–45 sustained TPS per H100 for single-turn, and ~20–28 effective TPS for multi-turn chat patterns (KV reuse benefits vary).
- Baseline config: 2x H100 for baseline (covers steady 18 TPS with headroom), scale to 4x H100 for sustained 60 TPS; add burst GPU pool or autoscale to cover 120 TPS short bursts.
- Concurrency guidance: set per-GPU concurrent request slots to 40 with continuous batching; tune max tokens to throttle very long sequences to protect latency SLOs.
- Private VPC: adds ~3–5 week provisioning lead time and adds ~12–18% to monthly cost due to networking and customer-managed infra overhead.

Attached: sizing_estimate_v1.xlsx (workback of assumptions) and a one-pager link to our Dedicated sizing guide.

Next steps I propose:
1) Send Helix this note + the workbook populated and ask them to confirm the Wed 16 Feb 10am PT deep-dive.
2) Prepare an internal canary playbook and a cost comparison (A100 vs H100) for the call.

I'll join the deep-dive — Sean can take notes and draft the canary plan.

Karthik
